title: UBC Thunderbirds
description: University of British Columbia athletic teams
extract: The UBC Thunderbirds are the athletic teams that represent the University of British Columbia. In Canadian intercollegiate competition, the Thunderbirds are the most successful athletic program both regionally in the Canada West Universities Athletic Association, and nationally in U Sports, winning 123 national titles. UBC has won an additional 24 national titles competing in the National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics against collegiate competition from the United States and 47 national titles in sports that compete in independent competitions.
